Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the maximum number of bird species on screen was 2 based on a misinterpretation of the transcript timestamps. The transcript explicitly states at 01:14 that an Adelie penguin appears ("Then, as if from nowhere, an Ad lie...") and at 01:26 that it "puts himself between the chicks and the petrel." This description confirms that all three species (Emperor penguin chicks, Giant Petrel, and Adelie penguin) are present simultaneously in the scene described at 01:26. The Planner failed to recognize that the Adelie's presence between the other two implies a three-species overlap, instead erroneously assuming the Adelie did not overlap within the same sampled second.
